title: Mysterious flickering brain signals could help to unlock secrets of consciousness
title_zh: 神秘的闪烁脑信号可能有助于解开意识的奥秘
abstract: Monkeys’ brain activity flips 15 times per second between patterns linked to objects of which the monkeys are aware and patterns for objects outside their awareness.
abstract_zh: 猴子的大脑活动每秒在与知晓对象相关的模式和与不在意识中的对象相关的模式之间切换15次。
